title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.03092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. translated_title: 化身智能：通过持久化个人智能体增强人类能动性
translated_abstract: 个人AI智能体在跨应用处理长周期任务方面的能力日益增强，但用户往往需要投入大量精力来指定目标、消除歧义和验证结果。我们认为，应以其增强人类能动性的有效程度来衡量智能体的进展：使人们能够在更少常规监督的情况下追求自己的目标，同时保留对重大决策的控制权。我们提倡“化身智能”这一范式，即通过跨情境和跨时间的持续决策委托，构建能够代表用户目标、价值观和约束的持久个人智能体。我们描述了从人类主导执行到委托领域内自主运行的成熟度路线图，并引入智能体监督指数（AOI）作为评估框架，用于衡量智能体交付的价值与其运营成本及人类监督负担之间的关系。我们指出了三个核心研究挑战：身份连续性……
tldr: 本文提出“化身智能”范式，通过跨时间和情境持续代表用户目标、价值观与约束的持久个人智能体来增强人类能动性，并引入智能体监督指数（AOI）框架，以评估智能体交付价值与运营成本及人类监督负担之间的平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Avatar Intelligence," a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints across time and contexts to amplify human agency, and introduces the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) framework to evaluate delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden.
